faq.q: How much does Joe Ecke Injury Lawyers charge?
faq.a: Joe Ecke Injury Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Joe Ecke Injury Lawyers offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Joe Ecke Injury Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Joe Ecke Injury Lawyers have offices?
faq.a: Joe Ecke Injury Lawyers publishes two offices, among them San Antonio. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.
